description: Humantic AI brings buyer intelligence into ChatGPT. Connect your Humantic account to read any prospect's DISC personality from a LinkedIn URL or work email (Agent Pi), generate account-research reports on target companies with buyer-intent signals (Agent Miia), and draft outreach matched to a recipient's personality. Humantic AI is our own product; this connects ChatGPT directly to Humantic's platform. A Humantic subscription is required and usage draws on your existing Humantic credits.

defaultPrompt: Profile this prospect's personality and tell me how to approach them.
Research this account and summarize its buying signals and stakeholders.
Draft outreach matched to this person's personality.
